contract_vs_churn.key_finding: Month-to-month contracts churn at 32.4%, compared to ~12% for Annual and Two-Year contracts.

internet_service_vs_churn.key_finding: DSL users exhibit highest churn (27.1%) while Fiber users show 13.3% churn in synthetic sample.

failed_payments_vs_churn.key_finding: Failed payment count scales churn risk monotonically from 8.6% (0 fails) to 26.9% (2 fails).

service_count_vs_churn.key_finding: Customers with 1 add-on service have 22.9% churn, compared to 11.4% for zero add-ons.
